candidates: When augmenting a third-party TypeScript module's interface (e.g., augmenting `@emotion/react`'s `Theme` interface), always use `declare module 'the-third-party-package' { export interface Theme ... }` paired with a side-effect import of that package — never `declare module '.'`. A `declare module '.'` augmentation creates a new, local interface that does not merge with the third-party package's original interface; any code that imports `Theme` directly from the third-party package bypasses the augmentation entirely and will not see the extended properties.
